name: Kingstar Office Cupboard with Glass Doors (KKOC014)
description: Melamine cupboard with full-height glass doors and multiple shelves. Ideal for display and storage in living rooms or offices.
details: This melamine cupboard features two full-height glass doors with black handles and a central lock. Multiple shelves inside allow for organised display and storage of books, decor or household items. The wood-grain finish gives a clean, modern look. Suitable for living rooms, offices or study areas in Sri Lankan homes.
